[Pre-reflection] The strategy's reliance on RSI < 30 and ADX > 25 for entries may cause frequent false signals during ranging markets, leading to overfitting. The exit condition using bollinger.middle crossover is too simplistic and may result in premature exits, especially in strong trending environments. The combination of mean reversion with trend filters creates potential conflicts that could undermine performance.
[Backup plan] If results are poor, I'd switch to a breakout-based entry with ATR multipliers for stop-losses and add a volatility filter to avoid low-VOL periods. If Sharpe is mediocre, I'd increase ADX threshold to 30 and reduce RSI oversold level to 25. As an alternative, I'd test a momentum + mean reversion hybrid using MACD crossovers with dynamic position sizing.
